name: Learned Correctability Threshold v147
oracle_policy: future lock-in labels are used only during threshold training and audit; held-out actions use frozen learned threshold + estimated EC

policies.fixed_ec_floor: require EC>=0.62 when possible, then maximize utility
policies.immediate_utility: maximize immediate utility over admissible actions
policies.learned_ec_floor: learn threshold from train episodes predicting future lock-in, then freeze for held-out test

threshold_learning: grid search on TRAIN ONLY to maximize balanced objective: avoid future lock-in while limiting unnecessary binding
